grammarFocus: was / were；常用过去式入门；be going to；because；基础句型综合复习。
title: A Saturday at the Bike Shop
instructions: 本材料为项目原创的模拟关卡，不是官方雅思试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先浏览题目，再独立听音并按顺序作答；作答期间不查看听力原文，提交后再核对原文和中文解释。单选题只选一项；填空须遵守各题词数要求并使用原文信息。本关卡为 A1 复习，共8题，所有理解题均为直接信息题。注意过去的 was/were 与计划的 be going to；口语迁移用简单句回答。
transcript:
Nina: Were you at the pool yesterday, Owen?
Owen: No, I was at the bike shop. My bike was broken.
Nina: Was the shop busy?
Owen: No, it was quiet. The repair was thirty pounds.
Nina: What are you going to do this Saturday?
Owen: I am going to collect my bike at eleven.
Nina: Who is going with you?
Owen: My brother is. We are going to ride to the lake because the weather is good.
Nina: I was at home last Saturday. I was ill.
Owen: Are you going to the pool this weekend?
Nina: No. I am going to bake a cake for my friend.

grammar.title: 用 was/were 说过去，用 be going to 说计划
grammar.explanation: 说过去“是／在”的情况时，I、he、she、it 和单数名词用 was，you、we、they 用 were；否定在后面加 not。说已打算做的事时，用 am/is/are going to 加动词原形，be 仍要与主语搭配。because 后接一个有主语和谓语的句子，说明原因。
grammar.example: I am going to collect my bike at eleven.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去时句子。
options: They were at the cafe yesterday.
They was at the cafe yesterday.
They are at the cafe yesterday.
answers: They were at the cafe yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示过去；they 对应 were。
questions.evidence: They were at the cafe yesterday.

questions.prompt: 选择正确表达计划的句子。
options: She is going to paint a box.
She going to paint a box.
She is go to paint a box.
answers: She is going to paint a box.
questions.explanation: she 对应 is；计划结构为 is going to 加动词原形 paint。
questions.evidence: She is going to paint a box.

questions.prompt: 选择语法正确、用 because 说明原因的句子。
options: I am happy because my friend is here.
I am happy because my friend here.
I am happy because is my friend here.
answers: I am happy because my friend is here.
questions.explanation: because 后的句子要有主语 my friend 和谓语 is。
questions.evidence: I am happy because my friend is here.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的过去时否定句。
options: We were not at work yesterday.
We was not at work yesterday.
We not were at work yesterday.
answers: We were not at work yesterday.
questions.explanation: we 对应 were；not 放在 were 后。
questions.evidence: We were not at work yesterday.
